## How did you test it?
- [ ] `node security-gate/scripts/gate.selftest.mjs` passes

## Checklist
- [ ] One focused change
- [ ] No new npm dependencies
- [ ] A tool that cannot run still gives `NOT-RUN` / `ERROR`, never a silent `PASS`
- [ ] No secrets, real reports or private project data committed
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/ADVANCED.md`, `security-gate/references/tools.md`) if behaviour or options changed
